<h1 align="center">Sam Hall-McMaster, PhD</h1>

![](assets/imgs/headshot_orange_circle_loose.png){width=40% fig-align="center"} 

<p align="center">
Human intelligence is flexible, but where does this flexibility come from? My research investigates the neural coding schemes and computational algorithms that generate adaptive behaviour. Originally from Aotearoa New Zealand, I completed a PhD at the University of Oxford and postdoctoral training at Harvard University. I am currently a computational neuroscientist at AllJoined, a neural decoding start up based in San Francisco.
</p>
